name: Mage
description: Mage OSS is a self-hosted workspace for building, running and scheduling data pipelines in Python, SQL and R. This script installs Mage bare-metal with Python and stores the project and runtime data outside the virtual environment.

notes.text: Mage is installed bare-metal with pip inside /opt/mage_venv using uv. Project files and Mage data live in /opt/mage_data so updates can replace packages without touching user pipelines.

Python 3.12 is the default because Debian 13's system Python 3.13 can force native builds of dependencies such as aiohttp. The script installs the requested Python version via uv and creates the virtual environment with that interpreter.
The script replaces Mage's default polars package with polars-lts-cpu, because older CPUs without AVX/AVX2/FMA can crash with SIGILL during Mage startup or project initialization.
Default login for Mage OSS 0.9.78+ is admin@admin.com / admin. Change the password after first login before exposing the instance beyond a trusted network.
The default orchestration database is local SQLite. For heavier production use, configure MAGE_DATABASE_CONNECTION_URL in /opt/mage.env to point at PostgreSQL as documented by Mage.
Optional connectors are installed from Mage itself, for example by adding packages such as mage-ai[postgres], mage-ai[dbt] or mage-ai[s3] to the project requirements and restarting the service.
